design.decision: Give up the lead with a [2] to reach the partner's honors or to keep a nil bidder from being forced to win.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first [2] lead; opponents win cheap tricks and get the lead.
design.rationale: Leading low trades tempo for points, a real choice; narrower and more deliberate than seed-low-lead, which fires 98% of rounds.
design.draftText: +20 contract points when your team leads a [2]

critic.concerns: Rank-only near-duplicate of seed-ace-lead and ca-king-lead.

history.note: draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-lead-rank-2-pts); credited to both sources.
